source.original_text: Tropp gives matrix-exponential positivity, expectation-order background, and the matrix-MGF existence caution, but does not print this generic standalone lemma or the literal four-family bridge. The author-derived canonical statement is: on any probability space, an integrable finite real matrix field which is positive definite almost everywhere has a positive-definite true Bochner mean; empty finite indices are allowed. Its private literal Gaussian consumer establishes all-real matrix-exponential Bochner integrability, positive definiteness of the true full-law mean, trace/integral commutation, and a strictly positive ordinary trace bounded by r²exp(|s|dR*). This is domain infrastructure, not a matrix-log identity or the source Bernstein conclusion.

blind_reconstruction.text: For every finite type I with decidable equality, every measurable space Ω, every probability measure μ on Ω, and every function f : Ω → ℝ^{I×I}, if f is Bochner integrable with respect to μ and f(ω) is positive definite for μ-almost every ω, then the matrix-valued Bochner integral ∫_Ω f(ω) dμ(ω) is positive definite. Here positive definite means symmetric with xᵀAx > 0 for every nonzero x ∈ ℝ^I. The finite type I may be empty; in that case this nonzero-vector condition is vacuous. The index and outcome types may belong to independent type universes.

/-! Positive definiteness of the true probability mean. This author-derived
canonical background reuses the existing PSD integral node and proves strict
positivity separately for every nonzero quadratic-form test vector. Generic
integrability and AE-PD data must be derived internally by source consumers.
Empty finite matrix indices are allowed. -/

open MeasureTheory
open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
noncomputable section
universe u v
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveDefIntegral

theorem integral_posDef :
∀ {ι : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
  ∀ (f : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ), Integrable f μ →
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (f ω).PosDef) → (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ).PosDef
 := by
  classical
  intro ι Ω _ _ _ μ _ f hf hpos
  have hpsd :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveIntegral.integral_posSemidef
      f hf (hpos.mono fun _ h => h.posSemidef)
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos hpsd.isHermitian
  intro x hx
  let L : Matrix ι ι ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun A => dotProduct (star x) (A.mulVec x)
      map_add' := by intro A B; simp [Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
      map_smul' := by intro c A; simp [Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul] }
  let φ : Matrix ι ι ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := L.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hfi : Integrable (fun ω => φ (f ω)) μ := φ.integrable_comp hf
  have hstrict : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 < φ (f ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hpos] with ω hω
    exact hω.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
  have hnonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ φ (f ω) := hstrict.mono fun _ h => h.le
  have hintpos : 0 < ∫ ω, φ (f ω) ∂μ := by
    have hne : (∫ ω, φ (f ω) ∂μ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hzAE := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hnonneg hfi).mp hz
      obtain ⟨ω, hωpos, hωzero⟩ := (hstrict.and hzAE).exists
      exact (ne_of_gt hωpos) hωzero
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (integral_nonneg_of_ae hnonneg) (Ne.symm hne)
  rw [φ.integral_comp_comm hf] at hintpos
  exact hintpos

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveDefIntegral

formulae.label: Canonical positive-definite true mean
formulae.tex: f\in L^1(\mu;\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)),\quad f(\omega)\succ0\ \mu\text{-a.e.}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\int f\,d\mu\succ0.

assumptions: Let \(\mathcal I\) be any finite index type, including the empty type, and let \(\mu\) be a probability measure on an arbitrary measurable space. Let \(f:\Omega\to\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\) be Bochner integrable and positive definite \(\mu\)-almost everywhere. These are the generic P data.

Positive definite means Hermitian with strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero vector. The mean is the actual matrix-valued Bochner integral under the displayed law. No common positive spectral lower bound is assumed. Empty index types cause no nonzero-vector obligation; P does not add Nonempty.

obligations.label: Author-derived canonical real probability mean is positive definite under integrable AE-PD data, with actual matrix-MGF consumer and omission boundary explicit.

lesson.title: Positive definiteness of the true probability mean
lesson.statement: The Bochner mean of an integrable finite real matrix field that is positive definite almost everywhere is positive definite.
lesson.formula: f\in L^1(\mu;\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)),\quad f(\omega)\succ0\ \mu\text{-a.e.}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\int f\,d\mu\succ0.
assumptions: Let \(\mathcal I\) be any finite index type, including the empty type, and let \(\mu\) be a probability measure on an arbitrary measurable space. Let \(f:\Omega\to\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\) be Bochner integrable and positive definite \(\mu\)-almost everywhere.

Positive definite means Hermitian with strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero vector. The mean is the actual matrix-valued Bochner integral under the displayed law. No common positive spectral lower bound is assumed. For an empty index type, the nonzero-vector condition is vacuous.

For the associated private consumer, \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), \(r=q+1\), \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), and \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\). This is the original unconditional product Gaussian law; \(q=0\) is included.

For physical rows \(i=1,\ldots,d\), let \(\alpha_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\alpha_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\alpha_i))\), \(\Phi_i=(\omega_b(i))_{b=0}^q\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Lean explicitly converts zero-based \(i\) using \(i.val+1\).

Let \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\), \(m_i=\int Y_i\,d\mu\), and \(Z_i=Y_i-m_i\). The cutoff includes equality and uses the same physical row; the Gaussian factor comes first in the paired matrix index, of size \(r^2\).

Choose \(w_i=1\) or \(w_i=\cos((2q+1)\alpha_i)\), and one global \(\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}\). Define \(S=\varepsilon\sum_iw_i Z_i\), \(R_*=2r(L+1)/d\), \(G_s(\omega)=e^{sS(\omega)}\), \(M_s=\int G_s\,d\mu\), and \(B_s=r^2e^{|s|dR_*}\). For every real \(s\), the Gaussian application gives \(G_s\in L^1(\mu)\), \(M_s\succ0\), \(\operatorname{tr}M_s=\int\operatorname{tr}G_s\,d\mu\), and \(0<\operatorname{tr}M_s\le B_s\).

All Gaussian probability structure, measurability, Hermiticity, radius bounds, exponential norm bounds, integrability and positive definiteness needed here are obtained internally or through existing canonical source producers. They follow from the definitions and the proved bounds. The trace is ordinary and unnormalized; the exponential is matrix-algebra power-series exponential. The signs do not assert equality of signed laws or MGFs.

steps.title: Test every nonzero direction and integrate strict scalar positivity
steps.text: Fix any nonzero x. The quadratic test φ_x(A)=xᵀAx is a continuous linear map on the finite real matrix space, so φ_x∘f is integrable and φ_x commutes with the Bochner integral. Almost-everywhere PD makes φ_x(f(ω)) strictly positive almost everywhere. A nonnegative integrable scalar function cannot have zero integral here: zero integral would make it zero almost everywhere, contradicting strict positivity on the probability space. Thus xᵀMx>0 for every nonzero x, which together with Hermiticity gives M positive definite. No lower bound uniform in x or ω is required.

/-! True matrix-exponential expectations of the literal original Gaussian
experiment. Every real parameter and both signs of both source sums are
covered. Integrability, positive definiteness of the actual full-law mean,
trace commutation and its explicit finite envelope are proved internally.
This does not prove a matrix-log identity, Lieb, or a Bernstein tail. -/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.L2Operator MatrixOrder ENNReal
noncomputable section
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityMatrixMgfDomain

private theorem actual_source_four_matrix_mgfs_integrable_posDef_and_trace_bounded :
∀ {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d),
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let α : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let tvec : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * α i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (tvec i) (tvec i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → M := fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Bool → Fin d → ℝ := fun useCos i =>
    if useCos = true then Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α i) else 1
  let sign : Bool → ℝ := fun minus => if minus = true then -1 else 1
  let S : Bool → Bool → Ω → M := fun useCos minus ω =>
    sign minus • ∑ i : Fin d, w useCos i • Z i ω
  let Rstar : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ useCos minus : Bool,
    let G : Ω → M := fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)
    let MX : M := ∫ ω, G ω ∂μ
    let B : ℝ := r ^ 2 * Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar))
    Integrable G μ ∧ MX.PosDef ∧
      Matrix.trace MX = (∫ ω, Matrix.trace (G ω) ∂μ) ∧
      0 < Matrix.trace MX ∧ Matrix.trace MX ≤ B
 := by
  classical
  intro d q hq
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let α : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let tvec : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * α i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (tvec i) (tvec i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → M := fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Bool → Fin d → ℝ := fun useCos i =>
    if useCos = true then Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α i) else 1
  let sign : Bool → ℝ := fun minus => if minus = true then -1 else 1
  let S : Bool → Bool → Ω → M := fun useCos minus ω =>
    sign minus • ∑ i : Fin d, w useCos i • Z i ω
  let Rstar : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  let : MeasurableSpace M := borel M
  let : BorelSpace M := ⟨rfl⟩
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by
    dsimp only [μ]
    infer_instance
  change ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ useCos minus : Bool,
    let G : Ω → M := fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)
    let MX : M := ∫ ω, G ω ∂μ
    let B : ℝ := r ^ 2 * Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar))
    Integrable G μ ∧ MX.PosDef ∧
      Matrix.trace MX = (∫ ω, Matrix.trace (G ω) ∂μ) ∧
      0 < Matrix.trace MX ∧ Matrix.trace MX ≤ B
  have hstructure :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixStructure.actual_source_centered_matrix_structure
      (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ j : Fin d, Measurable (Z j)) ∧ iIndepFun Z μ ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, Integrable (Z j) μ) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, (∫ ω, Z j ω ∂μ) = 0) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, (Z j ω).IsHermitian) at hstructure
  rcases hstructure with ⟨hmeasZ, _, _, _, hhermZ⟩
  have radius :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius.actual_source_truncated_matrix_norm_bounds
      (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ j : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Y j ω‖ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, ‖mean j‖ ≤ 2 * r / (d : ℝ)) at radius

    change ‖Y j ω - mean j‖ ≤ Rstar

      _ ≤ ‖Y j ω‖ + ‖mean j‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ) + 2 * r / (d : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add (radius.1 j ω) (radius.2 j)
      _ = Rstar := by dsimp only [Rstar]; ring
  have hw (useCos : Bool) (j : Fin d) : ‖w useCos j‖ ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases h : useCos = true
    · simpa only [w, if_pos h, Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one
        (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α j)
    · simp only [w, if_neg h, norm_one, le_refl]
  have hnormS (useCos minus : Bool) (ω : Ω) : ‖S useCos minus ω‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) * Rstar := by
    have hsign : ‖sign minus‖ = 1 := by cases minus <;> norm_num [sign]
    change ‖sign minus • ∑ j : Fin d, w useCos j • Z j ω‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_smul, hsign, one_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin d, ‖w useCos j • Z j ω‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin d, Rstar := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
        rw [norm_smul]
        exact (mul_le_mul (hw useCos j) (hnormZ j ω) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq
          (one_mul _)
      _ = (d : ℝ) * Rstar := by simp
  have hmeasS (useCos minus : Bool) : Measurable (S useCos minus) := by
    exact (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => (hmeasZ j).const_smul (w useCos j))).const_smul
      (sign minus)
  have hhermS (useCos minus : Bool) (ω : Ω) : (S useCos minus ω).IsHermitian := by
    exact ((IsSelfAdjoint.all (sign minus)).smul
      (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun j _ =>
        (IsSelfAdjoint.all (w useCos j)).smul (hhermZ j ω).isSelfAdjoint)).isHermitian

steps.title: Integrate the positive-definite matrix exponential
steps.text: For the same Hermitian S(ω), continuous functional calculus identifies exp(sx) with the matrix-algebra exponential exp(sS(ω)). The scalar exponential is strictly positive on the real spectrum, giving pointwise PD. The spectral bound |x|≤||S(ω)|| yields ||G_s(ω)||≤exp(|s|dR*) for every real s. Continuity of the matrix exponential and measurability of S give matrix measurability; the uniform bound under the probability law gives matrix Bochner integrability. Apply the shared lemma to this actual G_s and law to obtain positive definiteness of its true full-law mean. The route uses no uniform spectral lower-envelope theorem.
steps.formula: G_s=e^{sS},\quad G_s(\omega)\succ0,\quad\|G_s(\omega)\|\le e^{|s|dR_*},\quad G_s\in L^1(\mu),\quad M_s=\int G_s\,d\mu\succ0.

  let G : Ω → M := fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)
  let MX : M := ∫ ω, G ω ∂μ

  change Integrable G μ ∧ MX.PosDef ∧
    Matrix.trace MX = (∫ ω, Matrix.trace (G ω) ∂μ) ∧
    0 < Matrix.trace MX ∧ Matrix.trace MX ≤ B
  have heq (ω : Ω) : cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) (S useCos minus ω) = G ω := by
    calc
      _ = cfc Real.exp (s • S useCos minus ω) :=
        cfc_comp_const_mul s Real.exp _ (by fun_prop) (hhermS useCos minus ω).isSelfAdjoint
      _ = _ := CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp
        ((IsSelfAdjoint.all s).smul (hhermS useCos minus ω).isSelfAdjoint)
  have hPD (ω : Ω) : (G ω).PosDef := by
    have hstrict : IsStrictlyPositive
        (cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) (S useCos minus ω)) :=
      (cfc_isStrictlyPositive_iff (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) _
        (by fun_prop) (hhermS useCos minus ω).isSelfAdjoint).mpr
          (fun x _ => Real.exp_pos (s * x))
    rw [heq ω] at hstrict
    exact Matrix.isStrictlyPositive_iff_posDef.mp hstrict
  have hnormG (ω : Ω) : ‖G ω‖ ≤ Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar)) := by
    rw [← heq ω]
    apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hnormx : |x| ≤ ‖S useCos minus ω‖ := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus.norm_spectrum_le _ hx
          (hhermS useCos minus ω).isSelfAdjoint
    calc
      s * x ≤ |s * x| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |s| * |x| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |s| * ‖S useCos minus ω‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnormx (abs_nonneg s)
      _ ≤ |s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnormS useCos minus ω) (abs_nonneg s)
  have hcontExp : Continuous (NormedSpace.exp : M → M) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun A =>
      (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℝ) A).continuousAt
  have hmeasG : Measurable G :=
    hcontExp.measurable.comp ((hmeasS useCos minus).const_smul s)
  have hintG : Integrable G μ :=
    Integrable.of_bound hmeasG.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar))) (ae_of_all μ hnormG)
  have hMX : MX.PosDef :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.RealMatrixPositiveDefIntegral.integral_posDef
      G hintG (ae_of_all μ hPD)

steps.title: Commute ordinary trace with the mean and retain the exact cap
steps.text: Ordinary trace is a continuous linear map on this finite real matrix space, so it commutes with the integrable matrix mean and yields scalar trace integrability. Apply the existing canonical real trace-exponential envelope to each actual S(ω). The paired index has cardinal r² and ||S(ω)||≤dR*, giving tr G_s(ω)≤B_s. Integrate this pointwise cap under the probability law. Positive definiteness of M_s on the nonempty paired Fin(q+1) index gives its strictly positive ordinary trace. This emits neither a matrix-log identity nor a Bernstein tail.
steps.lean:
let tr : M →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Matrix.traceLinearMap _ ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htrace : Matrix.trace MX = (∫ ω, Matrix.trace (G ω) ∂μ) :=
    (tr.integral_comp_comm hintG).symm
  have hintTr : Integrable (fun ω => Matrix.trace (G ω)) μ := tr.integrable_comp hintG
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) = r ^ 2 := by
    simp [r, Fintype.card_prod, pow_two]
  have hpointle (ω : Ω) : Matrix.trace (G ω) ≤ B := by
    have hp :=
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.MatrixTraceExponentialBounds.trace_exp_pos_and_le_card_mul_exp_abs_mul_norm
        (S useCos minus ω) (hhermS useCos minus ω) s
    calc
      Matrix.trace (G ω) ≤ (Fintype.card (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (|s| * ‖S useCos minus ω‖) := hp.2
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnormS useCos minus ω) (abs_nonneg s)))
          (by positivity)
      _ = B := by rw [hcard]
  have hbound : Matrix.trace MX ≤ B := by
    rw [htrace]
    simpa using integral_mono_ae hintTr (integrable_const B) (ae_of_all μ hpointle)
  exact ⟨hintG, hMX, htrace, hMX.trace_pos, hbound⟩

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityMatrixMgfDomain
